selectionGuide.description: A four-frame dialogue shifts Padme from a hopeful assumption to concern when Anakin does not provide the expected reassurance.
bestFor: a plan that sounds acceptable until its troubling implication becomes clear
an optimistic assumption undermined by silence or ambiguity
a request for reassurance that becomes increasingly uneasy
avoidWhen: the premise ends in straightforward success
there is no hopeful assumption for the final panel to undermine
the exchange needs more than one claim and one repeated question

mechanics.visual: Repeated faces turn the same exchange from optimism into alarm; Anakin's lack of reassurance creates the implied answer.
mechanics.text: Put the plan or claim in anakin, then repeat the same hopeful question in padme-hopeful and padme-worried so the changed expression carries the turn.

slots.name: anakin
slots.hint: the plan or claim being made

slots.name: padme-hopeful
slots.hint: the hopeful assumption, phrased as a question e.g. 'for the better, right?'

slots.name: padme-worried
slots.hint: the same question repeated with concern (often identical text)
